items.quote: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
items.claim: The children of Israel, both men and women, brought a willing offering to the LORD for all the work the LORD had commanded through Moses.
items.actor: children of Israel (every man and woman)
items.object: offering for all manner of work commanded by the LORD through Moses
items.mechanism: voluntary giving: those whose heart made them willing
